title: The quasi-isometry classes of Galton–Watson trees: Lean formalisation
summary: Lean 4 formalisation of the automorphism-matching theorems and the quasi-isometry classification of Galton–Watson trees from the paper "The quasi-isometry classes of Galton–Watson trees" by Jayadev S. Athreya and Sascha Troscheit (arXiv:2609.23882). The audited statements are: the i.i.d. matching theorem on the binary tree (Theorem 5.1), the general Markov matching theorem for typed label processes on the binary tree, in its finite-type and zero-compatible forms (Theorem 6.1), the complete classification, up to quasi-isometry, of Galton–Watson trees with finitely supported offspring law…
